# [Baseline] - MAC - D - FileVault

Encrypts the Mac's disk and stores the recovery key in Intune. The macOS counterpart of BitLocker.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | macOS |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline macOS v1.0 — Disk Encryption - D - FileVault |
| File | [`Baseline_MAC_D_FileVault.json`](Baseline_MAC_D_FileVault.json) |

> The macOS counterpart of BitLocker; the recovery key is stored in Intune. Since September 2026 the personal recovery key is explicitly created (userecoverykey) and not shown to the user (showrecoverykey), so it can only be retrieved via Intune.
